thread:
Mira: Quick design review request — thinking about how streaming responses, stop/regenerate, and the token counter should behave in the sandbox. TL;DR: want less visual noise while keeping controls discoverable. (screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/mock1)
Devon: Nice — can you list the main pain points you hit yesterday?
Mira: Sure. 1) Streaming chat updates feel jumpy when tokens update in the top-right. 2) Stop button is tucked into the overflow; users don't notice it. 3) Regenerate should reuse last prompt context but we need a clear affordance.
Sam: Agree on discoverability. Also we should avoid showing token count for every stream update — it's noisy and pulls eye away from content.
Aria: From runtime side: token count updates are cheap, but we can debounce to 500ms and send a "final" token update on stream end.
Mira: Debouncing sounds good. UX question: do we keep the token counter inline with the message bar or collapse it into a hover/detail panel?
Devon: My mock: collapsed by default, tiny tokens icon with tooltip and long-press shows detailed breakdown. Keeps UI calm.
Sam: +1 for collapse. But make stop/regenerate primary actions near the composer — users expect stop near the streaming pane, not buried.
Kai: For keyboard users, we need shortcuts: Esc to stop streaming, cmd+R to regenerate. Also ensure focus state on the stop button.
Devon: Accessibility nit: colored stop icon alone isn't enough — must have text label or aria-label. Also ensure motion reduce respects streaming animation.
AccessibilityBot: Automated scan: color contrast for "stop" icon at 16px fails AA on light BG. Recommend 4.5:1 or add text label.
Mira: Good catch. For the token counter, proposal: show a compact icon (token#) at top-right that expands to a panel with breakdown (prompt / completion / cached). When streaming, the icon pulses but doesn't show numbers until debounce ends.
Aria: Implementation plan: debounce token updates, provide websocket event "tokens_stable" when streaming ends, include fields {prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total}. We'll keep the pulse as CSS animation off when prefers-reduced-motion.
Devon: Mock update: moved stop/regenerate into a floating toolbar above the message stream, left-aligned for less overlap with assistant avatars. Attached new artboard: https://img.redwood.local/mock2
Sam: UI copy: "Stop" vs "Pause" — which? I think Stop is clearer (users want to end generation). Regenerate button should say "Regenerate response" (explicit).
Mira: I prefer "Stop" too. Also add microcopy under token icon: "est. cost: $0.00" (rounded) — but show only on hover to avoid clutter.
Kai: Reminder: feature flag for A/B — experiment with small counter visible vs collapsed. Metric: time-to-first-click on stop/regenerate and average message scroll distance.
Devon: One more a11y thing: ensure toolbar has role="toolbar" and buttons are reachable in tab order. Add visible focus ring.
Mira: Great, next steps: Devon will push updated mocks by EOD, Aria/Kai to prototype debounce + keyboard shortcuts, Sam will draft copy for microcopy and experiment definition. I'll compile notes and open a PR for the feature flag.
Sam: Sounds good. @Devon ping me when mocks are up, want to iterate copy.
Devon: Will do. :+1:
Mira: Thanks everyone — filing follow-ups in the design board now (link: https://boards.redwood.local/board/324)
Aria: Quick question — when regenerate reuses context, should we auto-scroll to the regenerated message or keep user position?
Mira: UX preference: auto-scroll only if the user is near the bottom, otherwise leave them where they are.
AccessibilityBot: Check complete: after design changes, re-run contrast and motion checks.
